ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيَّ اَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْاٰنًا عَجَبًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul ūḥiya ilayya annahustama‘a nafarum minal-jinni fa qālū innā sami‘nā qur'ānan ‘ajabā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: "It has been revealed to me that some of the unseen beings gave ear [to this divine writ], and thereupon said [unto their fellow-beings]: "'Verily, we have heard a wondrous discourse,

ayahs.textArabic: يَّهْدِيْٓ اِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖۗ وَلَنْ نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ اَحَدًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yahdī ilar-rusydi fa'āmannā bih(ī), wa lan nusyrika birabbinā aḥadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: guiding towards consciousness of what is right; and so We have come to believe in it. And we shall never ascribe divinity to anyone beside our Sustainer,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annahū ta‘ālā jaddu rabbinā mattakhaża ṣāḥibataw wa lā waladā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: for [we know] that sublimely exalted is our Sustainer's majesty: no consort has He ever taken unto Himself, nor a son!

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوْلُ سَفِيْهُنَا عَلَى اللّٰهِ شَطَطًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annahū kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ‘alallāhi syaṭaṭā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'And [now we know] that the foolish among us were wont to say outrageous things about God,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ اَنْ لَّنْ تَقُوْلَ الْاِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā ẓanannā allan taqūlal-insu wal-jinnu ‘alallāhi każibā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and that [we were mistaken when] we thought that neither man nor [any of] the invisible forces would ever tell a lie about God.

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ يَعُوْذُوْنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوْهُمْ رَهَقًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annahū kāna rijālum minal insi ya‘ūżūna birijālim minal-jinni fa zādūhum rahaqā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet [it has always happened] that certain kinds of humans would seek refuge with certain kinds of [such] invisible forces: but these only increased their confusion –

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنْ لَّنْ يَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum allay yab‘aṡallāhu aḥadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: so much so that they came to think, as you [once] thought, that God would never [again] send forth anyone [as His apostle].

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاۤءَ فَوَجَدْنٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيْدًا وَّشُهُبًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā lamasnas-samā'a fa wajadnāhā muli'at ḥarasan syadīdaw wa syuhubā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'And [so it happened] that we reached out towards heaven: but we found it filled with mighty guards and flames,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِۗ فَمَنْ يَّسْتَمِعِ الْاٰنَ يَجِدْ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā kunnā naq‘udu minhā maqā‘ida lis-sam‘(i), famay yastami‘il-āna yajid lahū syihābar raṣadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: notwithstanding that we were established in positions [which we had thought well-suited] to listening to [whatever secrets might be in] it: and anyone who now [or ever] tries to listen will [likewise] find a flame lying in wait for him!

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدْرِيْٓ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيْدَ بِمَنْ فِى الْاَرْضِ اَمْ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā lā nadrī asyarrun urīda biman fil-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rasyadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'And [now we have become aware] that we [created beings] may not know whether evil fortune is intended for [any of] those who live on earth, or whether it is their Sustainer’s will to endow them with consciousness of what is right:

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوْنَ وَمِنَّا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَۗ  كُنَّا طَرَاۤىِٕقَ قِدَدًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā minnaṣ-ṣāliḥūna wa minnā dūna żālik(a), kunnā ṭarā'iqa qidadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Just as [we do not know how it happens] that some from among us are righteous, while some of us are [far] below that: we have always followed widely divergent paths.

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ اَنْ لَّنْ نُّعْجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُّعْجِزَهٗ هَرَبًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā ẓanannā allan nu‘jizallāha fil-arḍi wa lan nu‘jizahū harabā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'And, withal, we have come to know that we can never elude God [while we live] on earth, and that we can never elude Him by escaping [from life].

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدٰىٓ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۗ فَمَنْ يُّؤْمِنْۢ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā lammā sami‘nal-hudā āmannā bih(ī), famay yu'mim birabbihī falā yakhāfu bakhsaw wa lā rahaqā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, as soon as we heard this [call to His] guidance, we came to believe in it: and he who believes in his Sustainer need never have fear of loss or injustice.

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ وَمِنَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَۗ فَمَنْ اَسْلَمَ فَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annā minnal-muslimūna wa minnal-qāsiṭūn(a), faman aslama fa ulā'ika taḥarrau rasyadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'Yet [it is true] that among us are such as have surrendered themselves to God - just as there are among us such as have abandoned themselves to wrongdoing. Now as for those who surrender themselves to Him - it is they that have attained to consciousness of what is right;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ فَكَانُوْا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammal-qāsiṭūna fa kānū lijahannama ḥaṭabā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: but as for those who abandon themselves to wrongdoing - they are indeed but fuel for [the fires of] hell!’"

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنْ لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوْا عَلَى الطَّرِيْقَةِ لَاَسْقَيْنٰهُمْ مَّاۤءً غَدَقًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa allawistaqāmū ‘alaṭ-ṭarīqati la'asqaināhum mā'an gadaqā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [KNOW,] THEN, that if they [who have heard Our call] keep firmly to the [right] path, We shall certainly shower them with blessings abundant,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيْهِۗ وَمَنْ يُّعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Linaftinahum fīh(i), wa may yu‘riḍ ‘an żikri rabbihī yasluk-hu ‘ażāban ṣa‘adā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: so as to test them by this means: for he who shall turn away from the remembrance of his Sustainer, him will He cause to undergo suffering most grievous.

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّ الْمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annal-masājida lillāhi falā tad‘ū ma‘allāhi aḥadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [know] that all worship is due to God [alone]: hence, do not invoke anyone side by side with God!

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ يَدْعُوْهُ كَادُوْا يَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًاۗ  ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa annahū lammā qāma ‘abdullāhi yad‘ūhu kādū yakūnūna ‘alaihi libadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet [thus it is] that whenever a servant of God stands up in prayer to Him, they [who are bent on denying the truth] would gladly overwhelm him with their crowds.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَدْعُوْا رَبِّيْ وَلَآ اُشْرِكُ بِهٖٓ اَحَدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innamā ad‘ū rabbī wa lā usyriku bihī aḥadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "I invoke my Sustainer alone, for I do not ascribe divinity to anyone beside Him."

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنِّيْ لَآ اَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarraw wa lā rasyadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Verily, it is not in my power to cause you harm or to endow you with consciousness of what is right."

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنِّيْ لَنْ يُّجِيْرَنِيْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ ەۙ وَّلَنْ اَجِدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مُلْتَحَدًا ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innī lay yujīranī minallāhi aḥad(un), wa lan ajida min dūnihī multaḥadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Verily, no one could ever protect me from God, nor could I ever find a place to hide from Him

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖۗ وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَآ اَبَدًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā balāgam minallāhi wa risālātih(ī), wa may ya‘ṣillāha wa rasūlahū fa inna lahū nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: if I should fail to convey [to the world whatever illumination comes to me] from God and His messages." Now as for him who rebels against God and His Apostle - verily, the fire of hell awaits him, therein to abide beyond the count of time.

ayahs.textArabic: حَتّٰىٓ اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا يُوْعَدُوْنَ فَسَيَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥattā iżā ra'au mā yū‘adūna fasaya‘lamūna man aḍ‘afu nāṣiraw wa aqallu ‘adadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Let them, then, wait] until the time when they behold that [doom] of which they were forewarned: for then they will come to understand which [kind of man] is more helpless and counts for less!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنْ اَدْرِيْٓ اَقَرِيْبٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ اَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّيْٓ اَمَدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qul in adrī aqarībum mā tū‘adūna am yaj‘alu lahū rabbī amadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "I do not know whether that [doom] of which you were forewarned is near, or whether my Sustainer has set for it a distant term."

ayahs.textArabic: عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلٰى غَيْبِهٖٓ اَحَدًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: ‘Ālimul-gaibi falā yuẓhiru ‘alā gaibihī aḥadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: He [alone] knows that which is beyond the reach of a created being's perception, and to none does He disclose aught of the mysteries of His Own unfathomable knowledge,

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضٰى مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسْلُكُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهٖ رَصَدًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā manirtaḍā mir rasūlin fa innahū yasluku mim baini yadaihi wa min khalfihī raṣadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: unless it be to an apostle whom He has been pleased to elect [there for]: and then He sends forth [the forces of heaven] to watch over him in whatever lies open before him and in what is beyond his ken –

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ اَنْ قَدْ اَبْلَغُوْا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَاَحْصٰى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Liya‘lama an qad ablagū risālāti rabbihim wa aḥāṭa bimā ladaihim wa aḥṣā kulla syai'in ‘adadā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: so as to make manifest that it is indeed [but] their Sustainer's messages that these [apostles] deliver: for it is He who encompasses [with His knowledge] all that they have [to say], just as He takes count, one by one, of everything [that exists].
